         max(CASE WHEN glyph IS NOT NULL THEN line_pos END) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY line_pos ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS start_pos
  FROM leaf_lines
), captions AS (
  SELECT source_id, line_pos, glyph, start_pos,
         group_concat(primary_text, ' ') OVER (PARTITION BY source_id COLLATE BINARY, start_pos ORDER BY line_pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS caption
  FROM marked
)

         a.latest_min AS first_deadline, b.latest_min AS second_deadline,
         a.source_id AS first_source, b.source_id AS second_source

  JOIN drive_leg AS d ON d.origin_id = 'BASE' AND d.dest_id = a.station_id
  JOIN drive_leg AS e ON e.origin_id = a.station_id
  JOIN handoff_note AS b ON b.station_id = e.dest_id AND b.station_id <> a.station_id

         d.drive_min + a.unload_min AS first_finish,
         d.drive_min + a.unload_min + e.drive_min + b.unload_min AS finish_min,
         a.latest_min AS first_deadline, b.latest_min AS second_deadline,
         a.source_id AS first_source, b.source_id AS second_source

  JOIN handoff_note AS b ON b.station_id = e.dest_id AND b.station_id <> a.station_id
